history.problem: Locked out minutes after changing my password; mail on my phone still open.
history.fix: The phone's mail app kept retrying the old password. Removed the account from the phone, unlocked, re-added it.

history.problem: Account keeps locking every few minutes since the password reset.
history.fix: A tablet had the old password saved in its mail app. Cleared it on the tablet, unlocked.

history.problem: Third floor printer offline for everyone, jobs pile up in the queue.
history.fix: The print spooler had hung on printsrv02. Restarted the spooler and printed a test page.

history.problem: VPN disconnects every ten minutes when I work from a hotel.
history.fix: The hotel wifi throttles UDP. Switched the VPN client protocol to TCP.

history.problem: Outlook says disconnected every Monday morning and cannot send.
history.fix: Mailbox was over quota after weekend newsletters. Archived old mail so the quota cleared.

history.problem: Teams cannot find my camera after a Windows update.
history.fix: The update reset camera privacy permission. Turned camera access back on in Windows privacy settings.

history.problem: Second monitor flickers every few seconds.
history.fix: Faulty HDMI cable. Replaced the cable.

history.problem: Guest wifi shows connected but no internet on my new laptop.
history.fix: The laptop had no guest-network certificate. Installed the certificate from the portal and reconnected.
